notes.title: Major Update 1.0.2!
notes.content:
Hello Archers!
We have prepared a Major Update 1.0.2, check that you have Save 2020 actualized.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40011448/f255c4c698acaa5883f9afa8b88cd1b6ecfeafd2.png

List of Actualizations:


 Main Menu Full Screen bug Fixed.
 New SFX when the Archer receives damage.
 Loading Screen Fixed.
 New Animations for Dark Soldiers.
 Signs in the "Cave" have changed positions to improve player experience.
 Controller feel Improved.

notes.title: New localization for Save 2020 - Save 2020 on 8 different languages!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We know there is archers all around the world, that's why you can play Save 2020 now in your native language!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40011448/5c8496755117fc534ce8c79fec9aa14b6f62f9ad.png

New Languages:  

 English               
 Spanish
 French
 Portuguese
 German
 Russian
 Chinese
 Japanese


What are you waiting for 🏹

notes.title: Game Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello Archers,

Save 2020 game update 1.0.1 is ready, make sure you update the game for noticing these changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40011448/4a227c12107fd09c952c3a5d914655526a459ba9.png

List of changes:


 Fixed Load game mode.
 Fixed bug [Stand still for moments] in Knight of Death Boss fight.
 Fixed Bug [During Knight of death Boss timelines appears visual bugs].
 Make proper fixes to controller gameplay.


Thank you very mucho for your support and patience.
AlmanGames.
